fields.Appearance: Expressively dressed, with a cherished instrument and fingertips hardened by years of practice.
fields.Backstory: A traveling musician unknowingly learned a melody used as a coded message by rebels.
fields.Goals: Understand the song's meaning and choose whether to protect or expose those who use it.

fields.Appearance: Graceful and carefully made up, carrying costumes that can transform their apparent station.
fields.Backstory: An actor gained access to elite circles by impersonating nobles on stage and overheard a dangerous secret.
fields.Goals: Turn the secret into protection for the troupe without provoking the people involved.

fields.Appearance: Warm-eyed and animated, wearing practical travel clothes covered in small mementos.
fields.Backstory: A storyteller collects accounts of a forgotten disaster from communities that remember it differently.
fields.Goals: Preserve the truth, reconcile conflicting witnesses, and finish the tale before evidence disappears.

fields.Appearance: Compact, athletic, and bright-clad, with old injuries concealed by effortless-looking movement.
fields.Backstory: An acrobat left a famous company after its owner forced performers into increasingly lethal spectacles.
fields.Goals: Build a safer troupe and release friends still trapped by unfair contracts.

fields.Appearance: Always poised for an audience, with a quick smile and pockets filled with simple props.
fields.Backstory: A street entertainer became popular by mocking a local ruler whose agents now attend every performance.
fields.Goals: Keep speaking freely, protect the audience, and turn public laughter into meaningful change.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a storyteller.
fields.Backstory: Built a life as a storyteller and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.Goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a singer.
fields.Backstory: Built a life as a singer and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.

fields.Appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a celebrity.

fields.Appearance: A distinctive figure remembered as Nox Bellweather.
fields.Backstory: a fortune-teller whose false predictions are comforting and whose true ones sound absurd.
fields.Goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.
